_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory. Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: Google Trends API
tagline: Google Trends as clean JSON: interest over time, by region, related and rising queries and topics, with a trend summary.
description: Give it up to 25 keywords; get one JSON row per keyword with interestOverTime, a summary (latest, peak, peakDate, average, changePct, trend), interestByRegion, relatedQueries and relatedTopics (top and rising), the matching Google Trends sourceUrl, status and errorCode. Retries across IPs with honest RATE_LIMITED errors. Pay per event via Apify: $0.0025 per keyword, $0.001 run start (batch only). Failed keywords are never charged.
whenToChoose: You need to know if interest in a topic is rising, falling or flat: summary.trend and changePct are computed for you.
You need comparisons on one 0-100 scale (compare mode, groups of 5).
You need rising related searches for content or SEO ideas.
You need small outputs: outputMode=summary drops the timeline points.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: Absolute search volumes or CPC (Trends is relative 0-100), real-time trending-now lists.
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
